description: Measure the quality of a voice/VoIP path to a destination and return the estimated MOS (ITU-T G.107 E-model) plus live network metrics (RTT, jitter, packet loss). Useful before routing or starting a voice-agent call. The MOS is an objective estimate, not a perceptual measurement.

target.description: IP, host, or media endpoint to measure toward

name: measure_voice_quality
title: Measure voice quality
